zh: 一个以值 v 结尾、长度大于 1 的合法子序列，它的倒数第二项一定是之前出现过的 v−1。
用以“结尾值”为键的动态规划：dp[v] 表示当前前缀中以 v 结尾的最长子序列长度，扫描到 v 时由 dp[v−1] 转移。
用哈希表保存 dp；从左到右读入 v，令 dp[v]=max(dp[v], dp[v−1]+1)（不存在的键按 0 计），同时维护全局最大值并输出。
en: A valid subsequence of length greater than 1 that ends with value v must have a previously seen v-1 as its second-to-last element.
Use a dynamic program keyed by the ending value: dp[v] is the longest subsequence in the current prefix that ends with v, and reading v transitions from dp[v-1].
Store dp in a hash map; read values left to right and set dp[v] = max(dp[v], dp[v-1] + 1), treating missing keys as 0; keep the overall maximum and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let dp[v] be the best length of a subsequence of the current prefix that ends with v. When v is scanned, update dp[v] with dp[v-1] + 1.

## Correctness

Any valid subsequence that ends with this occurrence of v and has length greater than one must have an earlier v-1 as its second-to-last element; its best length is already stored in dp[v-1]. Appending v gives the best candidate, and taking the maximum with the old value preserves the prefix invariant.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), space O(n).
